evidence.title: Meta joins with group of companies to tame ‘chaos’ of doing business with AI bots

occurrences.quote_span: Enterprise AI startup Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, is part of the group.

occurrences.subject: personal agent protocol

occurrences.checkable_against: the personal agent protocol specification and implementation documentation
occurrences.quote_span: He said the practice will help with authentication so that businesses know if they're dealing with a bot, and will provide visibility into what personal agents are actually doing through these websites.
occurrences.speaker: Bret Taylor
occurrences.subject: personal agent protocol

occurrences.checkable_against: CNBC interview recording or transcript with Bret Taylor
occurrences.quote_span: "Companies will know when it's a personal agent versus an actual person. For a lot of companies there's a risk: you don't want just a random bot that isn't acting on behalf of a person to have access to this service," Taylor said.
occurrences.speaker: Bret Taylor
occurrences.subject: personal agent protocol

occurrences.checkable_against: CNBC interview recording or transcript with David Singleton
occurrences.quote_span: "We're defining rails that we hope personal agents and business agents can run over for the future," Singleton said, comparing it to email.

occurrences.subject: personal agent protocol

occurrences.checkable_against: the protocol documentation and Bret Taylor's Facebook employment records
